GLOBAL SPEC v2 — STYLE: 3D DIORAMA TAROT STOP-MOTION & DYNAMIC PHOTO EVOLUTION. Cinematic 3D tactile miniature diorama set based on the Rider-Waite-Smith (RWS) Tarot. Handcrafted 3D resin, clay, polished wood, and heavy paper stop-motion figures placed on a mini theatrical stage. Professional studio lighting with dramatic rim lighting, volumetric shadows, rich saturated color palette, and subtle tilt-shift depth of field.

SCENE SPECIFIC: A 3D miniature diorama of The Magician (RWS Tarot). A handcrafted resin figure of The Magician stands behind a mini wooden altar. On the table, miniature 3D objects (a sword, a cup, a pentacle, and a wand) rest in fine detail. Above his head, a glowing 3D infinity symbol (∞) floats with a subtle golden glow. The card illustration background transitions from flat black-and-white line art to warm vintage color, fully expanding into a volumetric 3D stage.

TYPOGRAPHY: Bold 3D golden serif text reading "EL PODER CREATIVO" resting on the lower third of the stage floor, casting soft shadows. Aspect ratio 9:16 vertical format.
